changes.summary: As a prelude to the exhibition Vuillard: Intimate Theaters, presented from March 23 to July 25, 2027, this display brings together several recent acquisitions that entered the collections by donation, spanning painting, pastel, and the decorative arts. This presentation highlights the richness of Vuillard's practice and how the artist explores the concept of the decorative through a wide range of techniques. Among the works on view are two major overdoor panels designed to complete the decorative ensemble Public Gardens, of which five panels are already in the Musée d’Orsay’s collection, as well as a set of pieces from the dinner service created for Jean Schopfer – a unique and experimental work in many respects that enjoyed great critical success.
